title: Upstart Finish
source: Engine-ready authored setup/solution for this pass; canonical A01 solution is in canon_reference. No decoded GBA fixed-board table was available when this script was authored.
notes: Upstart Goblin gives the opponent 1000 LP, raising them to exactly 2400 for Red-Eyes.

canon_reference.setup_status: unknown in A01; this pass ships an engine-ready authored setup
solution_steps: Activate Order to Charge, offer Mad Dog of Darkness and destroy Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon.
Use Premature Burial to bring back Mad Dog of Darkness.
Equip him with both Megamorph and Axe of Despair.
canon_reference.note: Canonical solution is recorded for traceability. The fixed board, time limit and reward below are authored and may need revision when A01 publishes the original setup.
